notes: Comparison build for the M5 iPad. For daily trackpad use, build 143 is the better choice based on host testing. Build 144 counted every dispatched block and exception in the six-core test and used 5–36% less CPU in fixed-work tests. After resuming full macOS on an M4, it submitted 19% fewer frames during scrolling and used 9% more modeled process power across four paired comparisons (medians). The dashboard now keeps the block count while paused. Battery runtime on the iPad is unmeasured.
